# Alternator replacement for VK-swaps

> **[Unverified]** This page rests on a single community report. Cross-check before relying on it.

> Items marked **[Partial]** are only partly confirmed by the source and need more work. They stay in the review queue and are firmed up, corrected or removed as more sources come in.

## Summary

[Partial] Apply antiseize, remove belts and brackets, wiggle pumps forward, then reorient new ears. [t766]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Needs more work: the verifier could confirm only part of this procedure (the steps marked [Partial], or whether the list is complete). Steps or precautions may be wrong or missing; read the source thread before relying on it. Later runs fill it in as more sources are found.

1. Apply antiseize compound to the necessary bolts.
2. Remove the serpentine belt from the alternator and power steering pump.
3. Drop the alternator by removing its two mounting bolts.
4. Wiggle the dropped alternator out of position and rest it on the steering rack.
5. Loosen five bracket bolts ranging in size from 14mm to 5mm.
6. Remove three specific bracket bolts while leaving the other two loose.
7. Unbolt the power steering pump using a 12mm bolt at the 3:00 position and a 14mm bolt at the 6:00 position.
8. [Partial] Align the larger hole in the pulley with one of the smaller holes to slide a socket over it for easier removal.
9. Wiggle the power steering pump forward until it clears the bracket despite attached hoses.
10. Remove the remaining bolts holding the alternator bracket in place.
11. Set the bracket aside and push the power steering pump forward several inches.
12. Reorient the ears of the new alternator as shown to clear the path.

_Procedure reported by [t766]. Photos of this job are in the source: <https://www.xterranation.org/index.php?threads/how-to-alternator-replacement-for-vk-swaps.8964/>_

## Tools

- 5-14mm socket set [t766]
- [Partial] 12mm socket [t766]
- [Partial] 14mm socket [t766]

## Tips & gotchas

- [Partial] Apply antiseize to bracket bolts beforehand for easier removal later. [t766]
- Consider replacing the alternator/power steering pump mounting bracket during the initial VK swap if possible. [t766]

## Common mistakes

- [Partial] Expecting the alternator to slide out easily above the frame rail without moving other components first. [t766]
